notes.title: [UI redone, battle upgraded, and a new version starting point]
notes.notes:
1. Change the overall UI to warm colors
2. Rework the art, details, layout, interaction logic, etc. of almost all interfaces within the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494795/73f32fd35856f5974cd79ce7cacb5598f6d3675a.png[/img]
4. Fixed many UI issues that affected display in previous versions, such as being unable to view information about a certain icon
5. Complete the advanced pet filtering function
6. Add shadows to combat unit characters
7. Optimize the skill bar, name and health bar display of combat units

11. The mall will sell seeds now
12. Mount experience pills and character experience pills can be used directly
13. Add more items

notes.title: UI interface elements redone
notes.notes:
In this game update, we have comprehensively optimized and upgraded the overall details, and strive to bring players a more refined and smooth game experience. First, we completely reworked the UI interface, optimizing the visual hierarchy and interaction logic to ensure that the interface is simpler, more intuitive and easier to use. By rearranging the layout and optimizing the button and icon design, we have improved the aesthetics and usability of the interface, while adapting to multiple device resolutions to ensure a consistent and smooth experience across platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494795/0b9d7bf7ae2ae466fb10b25f69e0803380608c54.png[/img]

In terms of pet system, we specially introduced a new female pet role, giving it a unique shape and personality, further enriching the diversity of pets. These female pets not only have exquisite appearance design, but also have unique skills and fighting styles, which bring more strategic choices and fun for players. At the same time, we have optimized the skill special effects and combat animation of pets, making the combat process more gorgeous and smooth, so that players can feel the dual enjoyment of visual and operational in every battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494795/098b5e06e96b5815782bc361c78d1d82676e638f.png[/img]

In addition, we have optimized the pet rearing interface and simplified the operation process to make it easier for players to cultivate their favorite companions. With the added interactive features, players can have more fun interactions with their pets and enhance their emotional connection. These improvements not only improve the game's playability, but also provide a richer and more immersive experience for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494795/60934b86e26709dbbb2d5b6f822b999db0d431fe.png[/img]

In short, this update aims to provide players with better and more interesting game content. We look forward to your exploration and feedback, and will continue to optimize and innovate in the future to bring more surprises and fun to players!
